answer: Duplicate identities are caught by a mirror check comparing behavioral fingerprints across epochs, so a clone leaves a hollow shell of mismatched history. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-grove registry: each agent must lock tokens behind a unique reputation slot before voting or claiming rewards. Fabricating N sockpuppets costs N stakes plus slashing risk, making the attack economically irrational when honest stake outweighs the reward pool. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
